The scoring formula

How we evaluate every opportunity

We don't generate random startup ideas — every score traces back to sources you can click. Each product opportunity is scored 0–100 on four weighted pillars, and each pillar is the mean of four dimensions — sixteen in all — scored against cited evidence pulled from GitHub, Hacker News, Reddit, arXiv, Product Hunt and the open web.

Demand

30%

Is the pain real, frequent and severe — with people saying so in public?

Monetization

30%

Will someone pay? Budget owners, comparable products, pricing headroom.

Buildability

20%

Can a small team ship it with today's models, data and open tooling?

Openness

20%

Is the space still open — or already locked up by entrenched incumbents?

The honesty rule: any dimension without verified evidence is capped at 6/10, and a URL only lifts that cap for the claims its kind of evidence can actually prove — so unproven claims can never carry an opportunity to the top of a leaderboard. Popularity metrics like GitHub stars never enter the score.

Compare

Put a whole domain on one chart

A ranked list tells you the order. It does not tell you which opportunity is cheap to build, which one is worth the most, or which one is defensible — and those are different questions with different answers.

Compare plots any two of 36 axes against each other across one domain or several, with bubble size and colour carrying two more. The default is the effort-versus-score quadrant every PM already reasons in — quick wins, big bets, fill-ins, money pits — split on the medians of the ideas you selected, not an arbitrary threshold.

Quality

Score, the four pillars, all 16 scored dimensions, and evidence integrity — how much of a score is actually proven rather than assumed.

Economics

Weeks to MVP, build cost, year-one ARR, ROI, payback months, LTV/CAC, market size, moat strength, competitor count.

Momentum

Evidence count, times rediscovered, and 7- or 30-day score movement.

Missing estimates are left unplotted rather than drawn as zero — an idea with no revenue estimate is not an idea worth nothing, and a chart that quietly conflates the two is worse than no chart. Every value is also in a data table beneath, so nothing is locked behind the picture.

The scoring formula

我们如何评估每一个机会

我们不会随机产生创业想法——每个分数都可以追溯到您可以点击的来源。 每个产品机会在四个加权支柱上得分为 0-100，每个支柱是四个维度（总共 16 个）的平均值，根据来自 GitHub、Hacker News、Reddit、arXiv、Product Hunt 和开放网络的引用证据进行评分。

要求

30%

人们在公共场合这么说，这种疼痛是真实的、频繁的、严重的吗？

货币化

30%

有人会付钱吗？ 预算所有者、可比产品、定价空间。

可建造性

20%

小团队可以使用当今的模型、数据和开放工具来交付它吗？

开放性

20%

这个空间是否仍然开放——或者已经被根深蒂固的现任者锁定？

诚实规则：没有经过验证的证据的任何维度的上限为 6/10，而 URL 只会针对其类型的证据实际上可以证明的主张提高该上限 - 因此未经证实的主张永远不会有机会登上排行榜的榜首。 像 GitHub 明星这样的受欢迎度指标永远不会进入分数。

Compare

将整个域放在一张图表上

排名列表告诉您顺序。 它不会告诉你哪个机会的构建成本较低，哪个机会最有价值，或者哪个机会是可以防御的——这些是不同的问题，有不同的答案。

将 36 个轴中的任意两个轴在一个或多个域上相互比较，气泡大小和颜色还包含两个。 默认值是每个 PM 都已经推理过的努力与分数象限——快速获胜、大赌注、填充、金钱坑——按照你选择的想法的中位数划分，而不是任意的阈值。

质量

评分、四大支柱、所有 16 个评分维度以及证据完整性——评分中有多少是实际证明的而不是假设的。

经济学

MVP 周数、构建成本、第一年 ARR、投资回报率、投资回收期、LTV/CAC、市场规模、护城河强度、竞争对手数量。

势头

证据计数、重新发现次数以及 7 或 30 天的分数变动。
